    Put People First 🫶🏼
    People and relationships matter most.

    Foster Freedom 🪁
    Life should be lived in a way that makes sense for you, without unnecessary controls or external restrictions.

    Be fair, honest, open, ethical, and transparent.

    With a vision to imagine and create a brighter future.

    Values we share as part of Attain Healthtech

    Break New Ground 🧨

    Power your career ⚡️
    Learn from industry experts, experienced leaders, and on-the-job opportunities. 

    Access parental leave 👶
    Get 14 weeks of paid leave for primary carers and 6 weeks of paid leave for secondary carers plus superannuation. 

    Work with flexibility 🏠
    We’re a hybrid workplace, balancing time in the office with remote work.

    Flexi Leave Days 🌴
    Get one extra paid leave day per quarter for what makes you happy.

    Take a floating public holiday 🫶🏾
    Acknowledge a significant day your way with family and friends. 

    Be rewarded 🏆
    Celebrate wins and recognise great performance with an easy and accessible Reward and Recognition program.

    As an organisation, we celebrate our diversity and welcome all people, regardless of their family responsibilities, ethnicity, faith, sexual orientation, or gender identity. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are encouraged to apply.

HomeMade, Mable, Leap in! and Mable Direct are entities under the Attain Healthtech Group of companies. While our companies are diverse, three similarities bind us:

1. We exist to create lasting, positive change across the entire care and support sector - impacting more lives, elevating standards and shaping the future of care
2. We believe in technology as an enabler
3. We’re driven by helping customers attain better outcomes

This position is part of the Mable team. 

About Mable

Mable is one of Australia's leading and fastest-growing healthtech platforms. As a purpose-driven company, we are where thousands of people with disability and older Australians have connected with independent support workers of their choosing and on terms that suit them. 

With more than 25 million hours of support facilitated since 2014, it's no wonder we have been recognised on the AFR's Top 100, Deloitte Tech Fast 50, were previously awarded Australian Growth & Technology Growth Company of the Year. 

By working at Mable, you will join a high productivity and dynamic team environment, leading to meaningful change in Australia's care and support sectors.

To find out more, visit https://mable.com.au/

About the role

This is a full-time role residing within Mable’s Customer Safeguarding team, who help to ensure that all customers on the Mable platform are appropriately safeguarded and supported. The role works directly with customers to understand their issues, explain outcomes, and achieve resolutions that keep our community safe and supported. 
 
The role blends excellent customer service, a passion for problem-solving, and a love for process improvement to support our customers in achieving equitable outcomes. 
 
You will be responsible for receiving and acting on Moderation cases that have been reviewed and escalated by the offshore team (a Moderation case is one that has been created by a system or algorithm, requiring human review). The Moderation Specialist is then responsible for determining whether or not cases are genuine issues via a process of assessment and investigation, before issuing appropriate interventions and liaising directly with Mable customers where appropriate to do so.
 
  • Serve as the escalation point for Moderation cases reviewed by the offshore Moderation team and requiring investigation and/or intervention
  • Provide detailed written accounts of actions taken in response to moderation cases, capturing the end-to-end process followed, the justification for the actions taken and the outcome of the review
  • Assess, investigate, and compile relevant information to support decision-making, making judgement calls where necessary
  • Issue relevant interventions to platform users as documented in Mable processes and procedures
  • Escalate complex, high-risk cases where applying documented processes and personal judgement do not achieve a clear outcome
  • Receive and make phone calls to platform users that are querying interventions issued to their accounts
  • Manage the moderation case process in accordance with all Mable policies and processes
  • Assess, resolve and escalate potential issues flagged by our internal algorithms
  • Communicate effectively with platform users and other stakeholders to enable mutually satisfactory outcomes
  • Participate in regular weekly and monthly reporting on moderation cases, paying attention to trends and potential anomalies
  • Proactively identify opportunities to continually improve internal practices procedures
  • Promote a positive and professional culture within the team
  • Undertake other duties and responsibilities as required
  • Experience in a customer-facing role, preferably with an element of conflict resolution
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills
  • High level of motivation and ability to handle a high-volume environment
  • Experience in handling challenging conversations
  • Calm, confident, and well-prepared
  • Ability to follow and implement written processes and procedures
  • Ability to clearly communicate actions taken and actions required by other Mable teams
  • Confidence using various software programs and systems (Salesforce experience advantageous)
  • Developed record-keeping skills
  • A customer-focused lens
  • Knowledge of best practice administration processes and procedures
  • Excellent attention to detail, time management and organisational skills
  • Team player mentality and committed to a high-performance culture
    • We’re powered by purpose 

    We’re Switched On 💡
    We know our customers because we listen and want to learn. We engage within the community and the sector and always act on insights. 

    We’re Bold 📣
    We’re ambitious and embrace creativity to solve challenges. We’re here to reshape the industry and back big ideas. 

    We’re One 🤝
    We channel our passion into a positive environment. We welcome diversity and collaborate to make the most of our different skills and ways of thinking.

    We’re Impactful 🌟
    We work hard to deliver change. We innovate and move fast to make a difference in the sector and people’s lives.

    Values we share as part of Attain Healthtech

    Break New Ground 🧨
    We simplify care with creativity and bold ideas.

    Make It Matter💟
    We put people at the centre and create impact that improves lives.

    Own The Outcome🥇
    We aim high, deliver excellence and drive results that last.

    Power your career ⚡️
    Learn from industry experts, experienced leaders, and on-the-job opportunities. 

    Access parental leave 👶
    Get 14 weeks of paid leave for primary carers and 6 weeks of paid leave for secondary carers plus superannuation.
     
    Work with flexibility 🏠
    We’re a hybrid workplace, balancing time in the office with remote work.

    Flexi Leave Days 🌴
    Get one extra paid leave day per quarter for what makes you happy.

    Take a floating public holiday 🫶🏾
    Acknowledge a significant day your way with family and friends. 

    Be rewarded 🏆
    Celebrate wins and recognise great performance with an easy and accessible Reward and Recognition program.

  • Identify and develop benefits that are genuinely valuable to customers and support engagement, retention and utilisation.
  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of customer benefit programs, from proposition and partner selection through to launch and optimisation.
  • Use customer insights, data and feedback to continually improve the benefits proposition.
  • Measure program performance and demonstrate customer and commercial impact.
  • Develop and execute a customer advocacy strategy that encourages customers to recommend and champion the brand.
  • Build programs that generate authentic customer stories, testimonials, referrals, reviews and other forms of advocacy.
  • Identify and nurture highly engaged customers who can become advocates, ambassadors or community champions.

  • Develop ways to recognise and reward customers for meaningful advocacy.

  • 5+ years experience managing customer, loyalty, advocacy, membership or engagement programs.
  • Strong commercial and customer mindset, with the ability to balance customer value with business outcomes.
  • Experience developing and managing programs from strategy through to execution.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to make decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong project and program management capability.
  • Experience working with customer training, education or compliance programs is desirable.
  • A strong understanding of customer lifecycle, retention and engagement principles.
  • The ability to influence stakeholders across the organisation.
  • Passionate about Tech and making a real impact on people’s lives.

    We channel our passion into a positive environment. We welcome diversity and collaborate to make the most of our different skills and ways of thinking.

    We work hard to deliver change. We innovate and move fast to make a difference in the sector and people’s lives.

    We simplify care with creativity and bold ideas.

    Learn from industry experts, experienced leaders, and on-the-job opportunities.

1. We exist to create lasting, positive change across the entire care and support sector - impacting more lives, elevating standards and shaping the future of care
2. We believe in technology as an enabler
3. We’re driven by helping customers attain better outcomes

This position is part of the HomeMade team. 

About HomeMade

HomeMade is an approved aged care provider dedicated to improving its customers' lives by empowering older people to self-manage their service providers with the assistance of our clinical and customer support teams.

Our transformative technology platform helps thousands of people retain choice and control by allowing them to create unique support plans that meet their specific needs and optimise their funds.

By working at HomeMade, you can play a crucial role in helping older people maintain their independence and live fulfilling lives in their own homes. You’ll be joining a team that is passionate and dedicated to making a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

To find out more, visit https://homemadesupport.com.au/

About the role

An exciting opportunity exists to join our team as a Support Specialist, helping people to live the life they want.

Reporting directly to the Customer Support Team Leader  you will be working closely with our Support Partners to deliver a personal, friendly, high-quality service experience as our customers go through all stages of the HomeMade journey.

To support our customers and keep operations running smoothly, we require flexibility to work within the hours of Monday to Friday, 7:00am – 7:00pm. Full-time team members work 38 hours per week, with schedules rostered within these operating hours.

  • Support HomeMade customers through proactive and reactive communications via multiple channels
  • Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound phone calls and emails (known internally as cases)
  • Work closely with the Support Partners to sign up, onboard and deliver ongoing support to Homemade customers.
  • Provide high quality customer support, guidance and training to customers to help self-manage their HCP and achieve their goals
  • Daily management of customer account documentation, including updating customer profile,  accounts and shift notes. Updating systems (Salesforce) and Support Partners 
  • Follow up on outstanding Customer inquiries, feedback and complaints.
  • Recognise unhappy customers and work towards a resolution or escalate where required
  • Liaising with our internal accounts team to facilitate swift onboarding of Service Provider, make payments and update Customer accounts
  • Engage in regular workshops and team meetings to evaluate current processes and procedures with a viewpoint to continuous improvement
  • Proactively work with customers to help get the most out of systems and Service Partners platforms
  • Adhere to team processes and procedures and meet individual and team KPI
  • Advocate for customers to ensure their needs are met and inquiry resolved
  • Assist the Onboarding Management with ad hoc tasks at the discretion of the Senior Manager 
  • Undertake other duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Bring empathetic and supportive customer service skills to our full range of customers and experiences, including responding to technical enquiries.
  • You will be proactive, a critical thinker and a great problem solver
  • You are a good listener, problem solver and people person
  • You pride yourself and gain great satisfaction in providing amazing customer service
  • You care about your customers and will always go the extra mile to get them the best outcomes
  • HomeMade is a technology enabled business, therefore we need tech savvy people who love to learn new things and experience troubleshooting
  • You need to be confident using Google suite, Salesforce, and cloud-based contact centre software or can demonstrate an ability to pick similar systems up quickly
  • Experience in a customer service, sales/account management environment is preferred
  • You enjoy working in a team towards team goals, deadlines and weekly KPIs
  • You approach work with high-energy, drive and internal motivation in a fast paced and flexible environment
  • Strong connection to, or interest in building an understanding of the Australian disability and aged care sectors and communities
  • You exhibit adaptability, resilience, transparency, trustworthiness, passion and innate curiosity
  • It’s important to note that while home/ aged care experience is appreciated, it's not essential to succeed in the role.
    • The values we live by

    Put People First 🫶🏼
    People and relationships matter most.

    Foster Freedom 🪁
    Life should be lived in a way that makes sense for you, without unnecessary controls or external restrictions.

Mable is one of Australia's leading and fastest-growing healthtech platforms. As a purpose-driven company, we are where thousands of people with disability and older Australians have connected with independent support workers of their choosing and on terms that suit them. 

With more than 25 million hours of support facilitated since 2014, it's no wonder we have been recognised on the AFR's Top 100, Deloitte Tech Fast 50, were previously awarded Australian Growth & Technology Growth Company of the Year. 

By working at Mable, you will join a high productivity and dynamic team environment, leading to meaningful change in Australia's care and support sectors.

To find out more, visit https://mable.com.au/

We are seeking a highly motivated Engineering Manager to join the Leap in! engineering group (part of the broader Attain HealthTech engineering group). The ideal candidate will be a well-rounded technical leader able to work as a technical, team and people leader.

This role reports to the CTO and is responsible for leading multiple Engineering squads both in technical direction and architecture as well as delivery and stakeholder management. 

  • Work as part of the senior engineering leadership team to help build a quality engineering organisation 

  • Assist squad leaders to maintain their backlog providing assistance with architecture and stakeholder management

  • Collaborate with engineering practice leads to improve core engineering practices across backend, front end, infrastructure and quality practices

  • Help to monitor squads delivery cadence and work with a team on improving on their efficiency

  • Collaborate on and recommend sound DevOps practices in the teams

  • Strong technical underpinnings - either through a bachelor of computer science degree or demonstrated self learning

  • Previous team lead experience

  • Good understanding of modern CD and software operations practices such as trunk-based development, 12 factor application principles in practice, utilisation of monitoring tools like Datadog, etc.

HomeMade is an approved aged care provider dedicated to improving its customers' lives by empowering older people to self-manage their service providers with the assistance of our clinical and customer support teams.

Our transformative technology platform helps thousands of people retain choice and control by allowing them to create unique support plans that meet their specific needs and optimise their funds.

By working at HomeMade, you can play a crucial role in helping older people maintain their independence and live fulfilling lives in their own homes. You’ll be joining a team that is passionate and dedicated to making a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

To find out more, visit https://homemadesupport.com.au/

About the role

As HomeMade continues to grow at pace, we’re looking for passionate Support Partners to join our team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in empowering customers to live independently, safely, and meaningfully at home.
 
By building trusted relationships, completing comprehensive assessments, tailoring support plans, and guiding families on options for self-management, you’ll ensure customers receive the right support at the right time.
 
Working in a virtual-first environment, you’ll bring strong rapport-building skills, aged care knowledge, and a consultative approach, while enjoying the flexibility to balance working from home with time in the office.
  • Managing your own caseload of Home Care Package customers who use one of HomeMade’s self-management options, delivering high-quality care and support.

  • Creating and reviewing care budgets in partnership with customers to ensure their Home Care Package funds are being used effectively.
  • Responding to changes in customer needs, and updating care plans and support arrangements as required.
  • Keeping accurate and up-to-date records, including case notes, support plans, and contact logs.
  • Monitoring how customers use their funding, and ensuring spending aligns with their agreed support plan and budget.
  • Handling customer communications, including emails, phone calls, requests, and referrals, in a timely and professional manner.
  • Collaborating with other teams – including Onboarding, Service and Support, and Clinical – to provide a seamless experience for the customer.
  • Contributing to quality and safety improvements, including identifying risks and participating in improvement initiatives.
  • Taking inbound calls when needed, and supporting both proactive and reactive customer interactions.
  • Delivery of all services in accordance with the Aged Care Act and Aged Care Quality Standards.  
  • You’re a natural relationship-builder warm, empathetic, and able to gain trust quickly.

As HomeMade continues to grow at pace, we’re looking for passionate Support Partners to join our team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in empowering customers to live independently, safely, and meaningfully at home.
 
By building trusted relationships, completing comprehensive assessments, tailoring support plans, and guiding families on options for self-management, you’ll ensure customers receive the right support at the right time.
 
Working in a virtual-first environment, you’ll bring strong rapport-building skills, aged care knowledge, and a consultative approach, while enjoying the flexibility to balance working from home with time in the office.
  • Managing your own caseload of Home Care Package customers who use one of HomeMade’s self-management options, delivering high-quality care and support.
  • Helping customers build confidence and capability to manage their own care, including using the HomeMade Customer Portal and connecting with their preferred support providers.
  • Using education tools and resources to guide customers and encourage them to get the most out of the HomeMade platform.
  • Working with customers and their representatives to complete assessments and develop personalised support plans that promote independence and safety, based on their goals and risk profile.
  • Creating and reviewing care budgets in partnership with customers to ensure their Home Care Package funds are being used effectively.
  • Responding to changes in customer needs, and updating care plans and support arrangements as required.
  • Keeping accurate and up-to-date records, including case notes, support plans, and contact logs.
  • Monitoring how customers use their funding, and ensuring spending aligns with their agreed support plan and budget.
  • Handling customer communications, including emails, phone calls, requests, and referrals, in a timely and professional manner.
  • Collaborating with other teams – including Onboarding, Service and Support, and Clinical – to provide a seamless experience for the customer.
  • Contributing to quality and safety improvements, including identifying risks and participating in improvement initiatives.
  • Taking inbound calls when needed, and supporting both proactive and reactive customer interactions.
  • Delivery of all services in accordance with the Aged Care Act and Aged Care Quality Standards.  
  • You’re a natural relationship-builder warm, empathetic, and able to gain trust quickly.
  • You thrive on delivering exceptional customer service and want to create real impact in people’s lives.
  • You’re confident discussing budgets and can explain financial concepts in a simple, supportive way.
  • You love problem-solving and are calm, organised, and decisive under pressure.
  • You’re passionate about supporting people to live independently, and you take a goal-oriented approach to planning care.
  • You’re tech-savvy and comfortable learning new systems – experience with Google Suite, Salesforce, or contact centre platforms is a plus.
  • Experience in case management, aged care, or customer support is preferred – but more importantly, you're motivated by helping others and eager to learn.

    Be Bold 💡
    With a vision to imagine and create a brighter future.

    Values we share as part of Attain Healthtech

1777e40e-06be-5b81-bd8a-38c33ede0dc1.original_description:
Want to help shape the future of eCommerce in Australia and New Zealand within a successful and rapidly growing team? A role within our Marketplace Team could be just what you're looking for!

We have a fantastic new opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join the team! Reporting to our Head of Sales – Marketplace, this role will support the acquisition and growth of new sellers, helping to bring the most relevant, best-priced product ranges onboard to further our customer choice. In this role, you will be instrumental in learning the ropes of marketplace dynamics while driving growth across both the Kogan.com and Mighty Ape platforms.

We’re looking for a motivated, commercially-minded, and customer-centric individual who is eager to identify new opportunities and help innovate our Marketplace offering. You’ll be part of a fast-paced, constantly evolving business where your agility and ability to respond to market trends will be the key to your success!

Whether you have a couple of years in a Sales/ Commercial environment and are now looking to explore your passion for eCommerce and technology, or are a Junior Category Coordinator / Assistant Buyer looking to transition from traditional retail into the exciting world of pure-play online retail, we want to hear from you.  Above all, you are driven by customer-centric outcomes and are excited about creating the best possible experience for our community of sellers and customers alike.

  • Identifying and Onboarding New Sellers: Proactively seek out potential sellers that align with our marketplace’s strategic goals and customer needs.
  • Vetting Incoming Leads: Assess incoming seller applications to ensure they meet our standards and criteria.
  • Building Strong Seller Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing sellers to ensure ongoing collaboration and success.
  • Conducting Market Research: Analyse market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities for seller acquisition.
  • Negotiating Contracts: Negotiate terms and agreements with sellers to secure the best deals.
  • Collaborating with Internal Teams: Work closely with other teams to ensure a seamless onboarding process for new sellers.
  • University Degree qualified in a relevant field (Business, Commerce, Marketing etc).
  • Commercially savvy, with demonstrated experience and success within a commercial role, preferably within a Retail or eCommerce environment.
  • Highly analytical and logical, and always looking for new areas of opportunity.
  • Able to develop strong relationships, through excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Have developed exceptional time management skills, being able to effectively manage multiple projects and timelines successfully.
  • Tech savvy and able to use various IT and cloud-based tools to improve efficiency and productivity.
  • An AI enthusiast who is proficient in leveraging Artificial Intelligence tools to automate workflows, analyse data, and enhance decision-making speed.
  • Ready to challenge, be challenged, and work within our highly disruptive business model.
  • Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
    • To apply
     
    Express your interest in this opportunity by uploading your CV and Cover Letter, outlining your interest in the position and how you think you can help grow the Kogan business.
     
    Hot tip, generic Cover Letters won’t cut it here! Stand out with an application that shows a deep knowledge of the Kogan.com business and how we operate, to allow yours to be looked upon more favourably.
     
    Innovative thinking got our business to where it is now, so it makes sense that we look for like-minded problem solvers! As a first step to our process, all new candidates will be sent testing, so be sure to keep an eye out for it! 
     
    About Us
    We’re Kogan.com, Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia.
     
    At Kogan.com we offer rewarding careers, where you build your skills, are mentored by the best in the industry and get to share your expert knowledge in an innovative Company where your ideas and opinions count. You get to solve really important challenges to drive eCommerce’s future,  and get to do it with a great team culture and benefits!
     
    Join Kogan.com to master your craft, do your best work, make a real difference and work with the best.  At Kogan.com, your work will have an immediate impact on transforming the Australian and New Zealand retail environment. 
     
    Heads up!
    Kogan.com is a fast-paced business - our vacancy close dates are subject to change. We will assess applications as they are received, so don't wait to apply!
    All new Kogan.com team members are required to undergo a National Police Record check and must have full-time Australian working rights

Kogan.com is a pioneer of Australian eCommerce, and the software we build is used by millions of customers every day. You'll join a fast-moving engineering team with real ownership, shipping to production daily and using AI as part of how we work.
 
As a Data Engineer you'll design and run the data and ML pipelines that let teams across Marketing, Purchasing, Logistics and Finance make confident, data-driven decisions.

  • Scalable Pipeline Development: Design and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines capable of handling 10M+ daily events and large-scale data transfers across our platforms.

  • Data Modeling: Develop and optimize data models in environments like BigQuery or Snowflake to ensure high performance for both analytics and ML training sets with optimal cost

  • Support ML Workflows: Build the underlying features and data inputs required for Machine Learning models

  • Develop and refine ML models for practical business use cases, such as customer sentiment, churn prediction or demand forecasting

  • MLOps Integration: Establish and maintain MLOps pipelines to help automate the deployment and monitoring of models in production.

  • System Integration: Work with internal APIs and third-party tools to ingest data efficiently while maintaining strict data integrity.

  • Governance & Quality: Implement best practices for data quality, security, and documentation to ensure our data remains a "source of truth."

  • Development according to software engineering best practices (Git, CI/CD, trunk based development, tests)

  • AI Collaboration: Contribute to experiments with AI and LLMs to assess how they can be practically applied to solve business problems.

  • Strong SQL Foundations: Solid experience writing and optimizing SQL for commercial-scale products (e.g., handling millions of rows and complex joins efficiently).

  • Pipeline Orchestration: Proven experience using tools like Airflow, dbt, or AWS Glue to manage and monitor production-grade data workflows.

  • Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for data transformation, scripting and interacting with various data sources.

  • ML Engineering Exposure: Practical experience building the data infrastructure that supports machine learning, including data preprocessing and model deployment pipelines. Experience with machine learning models development

  • Cloud Experience: Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, with a strong preference for GCP.

  • Software Best Practices: Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and basic containerization (Docker) to ensure code quality and deployment reliability.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A practical approach to engineering that balances the need for speed with long-term system stability.

    •  
    Bonus Points

  • Experience with event streaming (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) for real-time data needs.

  • Exposure to ML platforms and tools such as SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Databricks.

  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools like Looker or Tableau.

  • An interest in eCommerce dynamics and customer behavior analytics.

  • AI-Native Engineering: AI is deeply embedded in how our Engineering teams build and operate. We’re moving beyond standalone LLM use into agentic workflows, AI-assisted development and automation integrated into real engineering systems and processes. Engineers have access to leading AI tools, hands-on training and the freedom to experiment with new ways of designing, building and shipping software.

    • To find out more about how we work, our tech stack, processes and company culture, visit https://careers.kogan.com and https://devblog.kogan.com

Do you thrive on turning complex catalogues into seamless, high-converting customer experiences? At Kogan.com, we're looking for a merchandising SME to own the workflows, standards, and execution of our Merchandising team — ensuring products are discoverable, promotions are well signposted, and navigation delivers a great experience across Kogan.com and our subsidiary sites.

This role manages merchandising execution end to end, balancing BAU with major projects and seasonal campaigns, and acts as the go-to authority for best practice, process, and cross-functional problem-solving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Own the end-to-end merchandising workflow, prioritising BAU, projects, and seasonal needs against commercial goals and deadlines.
  • Build and refine best-practice standards, auditing frameworks, and dashboards to monitor navigation, search, and promotional effectiveness.
  • Act as the escalation point for workflow blockers, ambiguous requests, and competing priorities across the business.
  • Report on merchandising performance and KPIs, analysing engagement metrics (CTR, bounce rate, search performance) to recommend course corrections.
  • Lead the merchandising roadmap, cascading priorities and driving structured communication to resolve systemic issues.

Kogan.com is a pioneer of Australian eCommerce, and the software we build is used by millions of customers every day. You'll join a fast-moving engineering team with real ownership, shipping to production daily and using AI as part of how we work.

Every order placed at Kogan.com relies on the platforms this team owns. From inventory and fulfilment through to financial operations, you'll lead the engineering teams responsible for keeping these critical systems reliable, scalable and ready for the future.

This is a technical leadership role where you'll drive engineering execution, technical strategy and people leadership across two teams responsible for our Order Management and Financial Operations platforms.

You'll coach engineers, provide technical direction, guide architectural decisions and partner with stakeholders across the business. In a fast-paced, operational environment, you'll balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day priorities, ensuring the team stays focused on the highest-impact work while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and trade-offs.

You'll drive operational excellence, improve engineering practices and ensure our platforms remain resilient, scalable and well supported.

 

  • AI-Native Engineering: AI is deeply embedded in how our Engineering teams build and operate. We’re moving beyond standalone LLM use into agentic workflows, AI-assisted development and automation integrated into real engineering systems and processes. Engineers have access to leading AI tools, hands-on training and the freedom to experiment with new ways of designing, building and shipping software.
  • Our culture is unlike anywhere else and regardless of where you are in your career journey, we empower you to do your best work and have a big impact. Check us out https://devblog.kogan.com/ & https://goodteams.app/engineering/kogan.com
  • Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future.
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact.
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia.
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ.
  • Learning budget of $1000.
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
  • Lead, coach and grow two engineering teams, including Tech Leads and senior engineers.
  • Own delivery across SAP Business One and PSI, maintaining clear priorities, healthy backlogs and predictable roadmaps.
  • Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Warehouse and Product to translate business needs into technical outcomes.
  • Drive operational excellence through effective incident management and a pragmatic balance between delivery, support and continuous improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership by guiding architecture, coaching engineers and promoting engineering best practices.
  • Improve documentation, engineering standards and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Continuously improve delivery, system reliability and team performance.
  • 3+ years' experience leading software engineering teams, ideally managing six or more engineers.
  • Strong delivery and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced commercial environment.
  • The technical depth to earn engineers' trust and make informed trade-offs across ERP, integrations and operational systems.
  • Experience with SAP Business One or a similar ERP or enterprise platform is highly regarded.
  • A track record of building high-performing teams, developing people and improving engineering delivery.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to remain calm, decisive and customer-focused during incidents.

    While no two days are ever the same, as an Engineering Manager you will establish and maintain great stakeholder relationships, provide coaching and mentoring to engineers reporting to you, oversee the delivery of initiatives, monitor operational performance, manage technical risks and contribute to company wide technical discussions and initiatives. You will be able to pragmatically balance short and long term considerations as well as technical and commercial ones while strengthening our engineering culture.
     
    You will form a part of the leadership team for your area and will be jointly accountable for the health, happiness and performance of your team. You will contribute positively to the culture of the team, build engagement and morale, be involved in recruiting, set structure and processes and generally help build and maintain a high performing team. You will use your skills and experience to guide and support our next group of technology leaders.
     
     
    To find out more about how we work, our tech stack, processes and company culture, visit https://careers.kogan.com and https://devblog.kogan.com

12668e26-c232-50f5-bd71-4a131401a794.role: Expression of Interest - Category Manager Opportunities
12668e26-c232-50f5-bd71-4a131401a794.original_description:
Looking to shape the future of retail? We’re always on the lookout for our next retail pioneer.

While we might not have a live vacancy today, our growth never stops, and we want to connect with the best talent for future opportunities. We are welcoming expressions of interest from sharp, commercially-minded Category Managers / Buyers ready for a new challenge, as well as ambitious Assistant / Junior Category Managers eager to take the next step.

If you combine business nous with sharp analytical thinking, live for data, have an undeniable eye for trends, and love delighting customers with the most in-demand products, you’ll fit right in. As a key driver of growth and innovation within our Purchasing team, you’ll own your category strategy, expand our offering, and ensure a world-class experience for our customers.

This is your chance to get on our radar, reinvigorate your career, and join the pioneers of eCommerce in Australia and New Zealand.

  • Identifying commercial opportunities for category expansion including sourcing and developing new products
  • Engaging and sourcing key suppliers in World's best brand and Kogan.com's Exclusive Brands
  • Managing and engaging with key stakeholders, internally and externally, to build effective working relationships and achieve outcomes in alignment with the category strategy
  • Ensuring the most efficient logistics, warehousing and shipping options are chosen for each product
  • Maximising profitability of all products, through a depth of understanding of your category and the market
  • Being proactive, innovative and striving to continually develop your category for our customers
  • Actively negotiating the best possible trading terms and prices
  • Drive and control our promotional strategy and price changes across our different sales channels, and contribute towards pricing reviews when required
  • Ensuring timely sourcing and purchase of products and stock management, ensuring fulfilment of customer demand
  • Actively manage and monitor inventory levels to achieve company goals and KPIs. This includes planning promotional activity and actively reacting to market conditions Ensuring revenue and profit targets are exceeded every month
  • Monitoring performance and completing range reviews across your category and recommending actions where necessary
  • University Degree qualified in a relevant field (Commerce, Business, Entrepreneurship, Merchandising, Planning, eCommerce or similar)
  • Experienced as a Category Manager, preferably within an eCommerce, Retail or FCMG environment
  • Comfortable building and maintaining effective relationships, through exceptional communication and engagement
  • Highly analytical and possess commercial nous, being able to recognise opportunity and make quick, impactful decisions for the best commercial outcomes, so that we can continue to sustainably offer market-leading pricing to our customers.
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Being agile, flexible and adaptable is key to success!
  • A whiz with Microsoft Excel (we’re talking VLOOKUP and pivot tables, not SUM and AVERAGE - and we will test your capabilities).
  • Highly proficient with various IT and cloud-based tools, with a keen eye for leveraging AI to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and boost productivity
  • Able to apply logical thinking and think critically in interpreting data, leading to actionable insights to improve the best possible outcomes.
  • Ready to challenge, be challenged, and work within our highly disruptive business model.
  • Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • A hybrid work model and support on flexibility 
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape
  • You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
    • To apply
     
    Express your interest in this opportunity by uploading your CV and Cover Letter, outlining your interest in the position and how you think you can help grow the Kogan business.
     
    Hot tip, generic Cover Letters won’t cut it here! Stand out with an application that shows a deep knowledge of the Kogan.com business and how we operate, to allow yours to be looked upon more favourably.
     
    Innovative thinking got our business to where it is now, so it makes sense that we look for like-minded problem solvers! As a first step to our process, all new candidates will be sent testing, so be sure to keep an eye out for it! 
     
    About Us
    We’re Kogan.com, Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia.
     
    At Kogan.com we offer rewarding careers, where you build your skills, are mentored by the best in the industry and get to share your expert knowledge in an innovative Company where your ideas and opinions count. You get to solve really important challenges to drive eCommerce’s future,  and get to do it with a great team culture and benefits!
     
    Join Kogan.com to master your craft, do your best work, make a real difference and work with the best.  At Kogan.com, your work will have an immediate impact on transforming the Australian and New Zealand retail environment. 
     
    Heads up!
    Kogan.com is a fast-paced business - our vacancy close dates are subject to change. We will assess applications as they are received, so don't wait to apply!
    All new Kogan.com team members are required to undergo a National Police Record check and must have full-time Australian working rights

1944ae2d-81be-54bd-9657-3215b4116ac9.role: Expression of Interest - Demand Planning Opportunities
1944ae2d-81be-54bd-9657-3215b4116ac9.original_description:
Looking to master your craft with an industry leader? We’re always forecasting our next great hire.

At Kogan.com, our pace is fast and our product range is vast. While we might not have a live vacancy today, we are always building our pipeline for future greatness. We are welcoming expressions of interest from commercially savvy Demand Planners, Assistant Demand Planners, and Inventory Controllers who want to be part of our future success.

Reporting to our Head of Demand Planning, these roles are integral to driving accurate forecasting and optimal stock flow across our massive product range. If you are a proactive professional with an exceptional eye for detail, a curious mind, and a knack for streamlining processes, you'll thrive in our dynamic Purchasing team.

This is your chance to broaden your experience in a pure-play online retail environment and get on the radar of Australia and New Zealand's eCommerce pioneers.

  • Achieving forecast accuracy across all product lines by working closely with internal stakeholders on future demand
  • Actively managing and monitoring inventory levels to achieve company goals and KPIs, ensuring purchase orders are accurate and on time
  • Being proactive and proposing improvements to current processes, thinking critically, challenging yourself and others
  • Ensuring timely import of products and stock management, to ensure an exceptional customer experience
  • Understanding and minimising logistics and warehousing costs by effectively analysing inventory levels and purchase orders’ shipments sizes and frequency
  • Regular demand analysis and audit to avoid potential stock outs and aged stock, taking corrective action where necessary
  • Analysing performance of various product ranges and recommending actions to key stakeholders
  • Ensure we have a minimal number of sold-out products, monitoring them and timely updating of prices, presale dates and stock levels
  • Partnering with key stakeholders to ensure stock levels are sufficient, considering potential demand changes based on sales and / or promotional campaigns
    •  
  • University Degree qualified in a relevant field (Commerce, Business, Mathematics or similar).
  • Experienced within or have exposure to Demand Planning or Inventory / Stock Control, preferably within a Retail, eCommerce or FMCG environment. Experience with SAP or Netstock will be well regarded
  • Highly analytical, logical and ready to delve into data - being able to evaluate offers and products quickly to determine if they’re of value to our customers is key.
  • Able to develop strong and effective relationships, through excellent communication and negotiation skills

Reporting to our Head of Demand Planning, these roles are integral to driving accurate forecasting and optimal stock flow across our massive product range. If you are a proactive professional with an exceptional eye for detail, a curious mind, and a knack for streamlining processes, you'll thrive in our dynamic Purchasing team.

This is your chance to broaden your experience in a pure-play online retail environment and get on the radar of Australia and New Zealand's eCommerce pioneers.

  • Achieving forecast accuracy across all product lines by working closely with internal stakeholders on future demand

  • Ensuring timely import of products and stock management, to ensure an exceptional customer experience
  • Understanding and minimising logistics and warehousing costs by effectively analysing inventory levels and purchase orders’ shipments sizes and frequency
  • Regular demand analysis and audit to avoid potential stock outs and aged stock, taking corrective action where necessary
  • Analysing performance of various product ranges and recommending actions to key stakeholders
  • Ensure we have a minimal number of sold-out products, monitoring them and timely updating of prices, presale dates and stock levels

  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ

1369a6ab-573f-5880-8d59-e077638faca6.original_description:
This is an expression of interest to join our talent pipeline. While we don't have an immediate opening, we're always keen to connect with great talent for future opportunities.
 
Kogan.com is a pioneer of Australian eCommerce, and the software we build is used by millions of customers every day. You'll join a fast-moving team with real ownership, shipping to production daily and using AI as part of how we work.
 
We'd love to hear from talented Business Analysts and Product Owners who turn ideas into features that deliver real impact for millions of customers.
  • Break down business goals into smaller deliverables that engineers can iteratively push through to production.
  • Gain a good understanding of business domains and act as the SME and stakeholder proxy to the engineering team, influencing and managing the scope of engineering work in line with the business priorities.
  • Understand and document acceptance criteria agreed to by stakeholders and engineers.
  • Prioritise and maintain the backlog for assigned products, balancing the requirements of stakeholders.
  • Assist in the planning and coordination of product releases - this includes collaborating with the engineering team, setting release goals and ensuring timely delivery of features.
  • Work well in a team environment to facilitate scope management, quality and timeliness as a requirement makes it way through the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Work across multiple projects and initiatives across all stages of the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Drive the focus on shipping to production as quickly as possible.
  • Understand, analyse and document estimated and actual business value delivered to provide insights into future improvement.
  • Accurately report on progress of tasks and projects, keeping in continual communication with project teams and management about project progress, issues and other relevant items.
  • Clearly communicate to stakeholders and developers on progress of both individual and team tasks.
  • A minimum of 3 years experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner with a solid understanding of all aspects of the agile software development cycle.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to run workshops, showcases and to communicate effectively with engineers and other stakeholders across the organization.
  • Experimental & super motivated to try something new and not be afraid to suggest it.
  • Developed analytical skills including ability to interpret business needs and develop appropriate technical solutions.
  • Ability to understand and document technical requirements.
  • Developed problem solving skills and ability to think creatively.
  • Ability to effectively manage competing stakeholder priorities and objectives
  • Work productively in a fast paced and agile environment.
  • AI-Native Engineering: AI is deeply embedded in how our Engineering teams build and operate. We’re moving beyond standalone LLM use into agentic workflows, AI-assisted development and automation integrated into real engineering systems and processes. Engineers have access to leading AI tools, hands-on training and the freedom to experiment with new ways of designing, building and shipping software.
  • Our culture is unlike anywhere else and regardless of where you are in your career journey, we empower you to do your best work and have a big impact. Check us out https://devblog.kogan.com/ & https://goodteams.app/teams/kogan.com.
  • Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact.
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
    • To find out more about how we work, our tech stack, processes and company culture, visit https://careers.kogan.com and https://devblog.kogan.com

Kogan.com is on the hunt for a talented and motivated Graphic Designer to produce high-quality visual assets across a wide range of channels.
 
Reporting to the Graphic Design Manager, this role is perfect for a mid-level designer looking to take the next step in a dynamic, fast-paced eCommerce environment.
 
You’ll play a key role in bringing campaign creative to life—from concept through to execution—across digital, print, packaging, social media, and more. With room to lead on ideation and animation, this is a fantastic opportunity to shape the visual identity of one of Australia’s most recognised online retailers.
 
If you’re a creative thinker with strong attention to detail, excellent technical skills, and a passion for producing polished, effective design—apply now and help drive creative excellence at scale.
  • Designing a wide range of marketing and campaign assets across digital, print, website, packaging, email, social and paid media
  • Leading ideation and execution of campaign creative across multiple platforms
  • Creating and editing product and listing images, including photography and post-production
  • Producing animated assets using After Effects for use in social and paid media
  • Assisting with corporate communications and internal collateral as needed
  • Ensuring all work aligns with brief requirements and brand guidelines, and is delivered to a high standard
  • Providing feedback and support to other designers, contributing to continuous improvement
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective delivery of projects
  • Degree qualified in a relevant field (Design, Marketing, Communications or similar)
  • A mid-level designer with proven experience in a similar, fast-paced environment, ideally eCommerce or Retail
  • Proficient in the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and After Effects
  • Able to pair your creative intuition with AI tools to streamline production and make data-informed design decisions
  • Able to manage multiple deadlines while maintaining a strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a collaborative creative team
  • Skilled in transforming briefs into compelling, brand-aligned designs
  • Open to feedback and always seeking to push creative boundaries
  • Organised, efficient and process-oriented
  • Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape
  • You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
    • To apply
     
    Express your interest in this opportunity by uploading your CV and Cover Letter, outlining your interest in the position and how you think you can help grow the Kogan business.
     
    Hot tip, generic Cover Letters won’t cut it here! Stand out with an application that shows a deep knowledge of the Kogan.com business and how we operate, to allow yours to be looked upon more favourably.
     
    Innovative thinking got our business to where it is now, so it makes sense that we look for like-minded problem solvers! As a first step to our process, all new candidates will be sent testing, so be sure to keep an eye out for it! 
     
    About Us
    We’re Kogan.com, Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia.
     
    At Kogan.com we offer rewarding careers, where you build your skills, are mentored by the best in the industry and get to share your expert knowledge in an innovative Company where your ideas and opinions count. You get to solve really important challenges to drive eCommerce’s future,  and get to do it with a great team culture and benefits!
     
    Join Kogan.com to master your craft, do your best work, make a real difference and work with the best.  At Kogan.com, your work will have an immediate impact on transforming the Australian and New Zealand retail environment. 
     
    Heads up!
    Kogan.com is a fast-paced business - our vacancy close dates are subject to change. We will assess applications as they are received, so don't wait to apply!
    All new Kogan.com team members are required to undergo a National Police Record check and must have full-time Australian working rights

Ready to turn your passion for tech into an exceptional product offering?

Due to rapid growth, we have a brand-new opportunity for a tech-savvy Junior Category Manager to join our Tech & Electronics divisions within the Purchasing team! Looking after our iconic consumer electronics portfolio, you will be the commercial driving force behind curating our product range, ensuring Kogan.com customers always have access to the most in-demand, trending tech on the market.

Reporting directly to the Director of Purchasing, you will have true ownership of your category portfolio. You’ll be responsible for developing exciting new products, building strong supplier partnerships, managing P&L responsibilities, and leveraging the latest data and AI tools to optimize your strategy and stay ahead of market trends.

This is a brilliant step-up opportunity if you are:

  • An ambitious Assistant Buyer / Category Assistant ready to challenge yourself with category ownership.

  • An Allocator / Planner looking to successfully pivot into the product and buying space.

  • An existing Junior Category Manager / Buyer looking to amplify your sourcing expertise within a leading, fast-paced eCommerce business.

If you are data-driven, outcome-focused, and love the tech space, apply today to take the next major step in your career!

  • Identifying commercial opportunities for expansion of category including sourcing and developing new products
  • Engaging and sourcing key suppliers, locally and internationally,  in World's best brand and Kogan.com's Exclusive Brands
  • Actively managing daily category operations including; planning and promotional activity,  inventory management, shipping and logistics  to ensure revenue and profit targets are exceeded every month
  • Managing and engaging with key stakeholders, internally and externally, to build effective working relationships and achieve outcomes
  • Maximising profitability of all products, through a depth of understanding of your category and the market
  • Being proactive, innovative and striving to continually develop your category for our customers

Kogan.com is a pioneer of Australian eCommerce, and the software we build is used by millions of customers every day. You'll join a fast-moving engineering team with real ownership, shipping to production daily and using AI as part of how we work.
 
As a Data Engineer you'll design and run the data and ML pipelines that let teams across Marketing, Purchasing, Logistics and Finance make confident, data-driven decisions.
  • Machine Learning Development: Design, build and deploy machine learning models that solve practical business problems, including recommendation systems, demand forecasting, customer segmentation, churn prediction, pricing optimisation and fraud detection.
  • Production ML Systems: Build reliable and scalable machine learning services that deliver predictions in both real time and batch environments, ensuring strong performance, reliability and cost efficiency.
  • MLOps & Automation: Develop and maintain MLOps pipelines that automate model training, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
  • Feature Engineering: Work with large datasets to create robust feature pipelines and reusable datasets that improve model performance and accelerate experimentation.
  • LLM & Generative AI Applications: Design, evaluate and deploy AI powered solutions using large language models (LLMs), retrieval systems, agents and emerging AI technologies to enhance customer experiences and internal productivity.
  • Model Monitoring & Optimisation: Implement monitoring frameworks to track model performance, drift, accuracy and business impact, continuously improving models in production.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Analysts and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where machine learning can create measurable value.
  • Software Engineering Excellence: Develop solutions in line with software engineering best practices, including Git, CI/CD, trunk based development, testing and observability.
  • AI Collaboration: Contribute to experiments with AI and emerging technologies, helping shape how Kogan.com leverages machine learning and automation across the business.
    • Strong Python Skills: Commercial experience building machine learning applications and data pipelines using Python and relevant machine learning libraries.
    • Machine Learning Expertise: Hands on experience developing, evaluating and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
    • MLOps Experience: Experience building and maintaining model deployment, monitoring and retraining pipelines using modern MLOps practices and tools.
    • Data Engineering Foundations: Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, feature engineering workflows and distributed data processing systems.
    • Cloud Experience: Hands on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Vertex AI, BigQuery and Cloud Run.
    • Software Engineering Best Practices: Strong understanding of Git, CI/CD, testing frameworks, containerisation and production system reliability.
    • AI & LLM Experience: Experience working with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architectures or AI agents through commercial or personal projects.
    • Problem Solving Mindset: A practical engineering approach that balances experimentation and innovation with reliability, scalability and business impact.

      • Bonus Points

      • Recommendation & Forecasting Systems: Experience building recommendation systems, search ranking models or forecasting solutions.
      • ML Platforms & Tooling: Exposure to ML platforms and tools such as Vertex AI, Databricks, SageMaker or Kubeflow.
      • Streaming & Event Driven Systems: Experience with event driven architectures and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Pub/Sub.
      • LLM Application Deployment: Experience deploying AI applications powered by LLMs and agent frameworks.
  • AI-Native Engineering: AI is deeply embedded in how our Engineering teams build and operate. We’re moving beyond standalone LLM use into agentic workflows, AI-assisted development and automation integrated into real engineering systems and processes. Engineers have access to leading AI tools, hands-on training and the freedom to experiment with new ways of designing, building and shipping software.
  • Our culture is unlike anywhere else and regardless of where you are in your career journey, we empower you to do your best work and have a big impact. Check us out https://devblog.kogan.com/ & https://goodteams.app/teams/kogan.com.
  • Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand's eCommerce future.
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You'll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact.
  • You'll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia.
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ.
  • Learning budget of $1000.
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
    • To find out more about how we work, our tech stack, processes and company culture, visit https://careers.kogan.com and https://devblog.kogan.com

parsed.title: Patient Support Specialist (Immediate Start)
parsed.description_text: About Eucalyptus We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care. Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness. Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times. Our Growth Story: Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada. About the Role This isn't your ordinary customer support role. You will take real ownership of patient issues and deliver high-quality care across every channel. As a Patient Support Specialist, you're the frontline of the patient experience. We're scaling our Sydney team fast and need people who can start now, hit the ground running, and keep our patients moving — especially across live chat and calls, where speed matters most. We're looking for strong customer service profiles who love solving problems and delivering for the people on the other side of every interaction. In this role, you'll: Support patients across every channel (email, live chat, and inbound/outbound calls), delivering timely, accurate, empathetic help within SLA. Own the problem, not just the interaction. You'll take issues from first contact through to resolution, no handoff without a handover. Move fast on live channels, since a big part of this role is real-time support helping patients get answers in minutes, not hours. Coordinate across teams, working with our doctors, pharmacies, and delivery partners in Manila, Sydney, and remote to get patients the right outcome. Escalate smartly by resolving what's in scope, escalating what isn't, always with full context and a recommendation. Hit the standard, consistently meeting CSAT, tickets-solved, and handling-time targets without trading quality for speed. Spot patterns and surface recurring issues and ideas that make the whole operation better. About You You'll need to bring: 2+ years in customer service, telehealth/healthcare support, tech support, or a similar problem-solving role, comfortable across email, chat, and calls. Excellent written and verbal English, You'll need to communicate clearly and warmly, and be and able to flex your tone to the situation. Strong problem-skills and genuine ownership, always thinking a step ahead. Strong attention to detail Technological proficiency and quickness to adapt to customer support tools; Mac and Google Suite experience a plus. Genuine care for patients and their health journey. We're also looking for people who are ideally available immediately. Working Holiday visa holders with immediate, ongoing availability are welcome to apply. This is a fixed-term contract role (~3-month engagement), full-time hours 9–5 Monday–Friday, based in Sydney (hybrid), immediate start. Why join Eucalyptus? Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men's health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health. Here's what makes joining Euc unique: Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan; collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa; and explore new markets or travel internationally. Recognised on Hatch's Hotlist as one of Australia's top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders. Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture. Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, whoops to track your wellbeing, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties. Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare. Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, to health, professional development, and personal days, Whoop membership, and our Employee Assistance Program. What's ahead in Australia? Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We're launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem. We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding. You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets. You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support. You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale. At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.
